title: Root-cause the npm PTY test that failed only in the v0.7.1 release run
body:
Root-cause the CI-only failure of terminal::tests::spawn_argv_npm_codex_preserves_card_prompt_through_pty (src/terminal.rs; added a0517a0). Read the skills first: foreman-proof-and-analysis-toolkit (section 7, race root-causing) and foreman-validation-and-qa (flaky policy).

## Evidence so far
- Failed in release.yml run 37414213018, BOTH attempts (tag v0.7.1, commit 97fe186): grid still blank after the 15 s deadline. The message then was only "npm launch failed: " plus blank lines.
- Passed in test.yml on the same commit (run 37414210695), on 09acd5d (37535604521) and on 6b14f76 (37537676098). It also passed in release.yml for v0.7.0 (37396432506). Every run used runner image windows-2025-vs2026 20260925.250.1.
- Passes locally. snapshot_text() pumps on every call, so the pre-Ready swallow / DSR trap is ruled out.
- 2c78d62 made the failure message name the program ("codex" bare, or the explicit codex.cmd path) and the exit state. Get logs from code at or after that commit.
- release.yml no longer runs cargo test (50b1c7f), so the original failing setup no longer exists in CI.

## Open question
Is this tied to release.yml's setup (tag checkout / detached HEAD, permissions contents: write, no concurrency group), or plain chance? 2 of the 3 release.yml runs failed, but those 2 are attempts at the same tag. Start with a census: list every test.yml and release.yml run since a0517a0 (gh run list / gh run view --log) and record this test's result in each.

## How to reproduce in CI
Probe workflows go ONLY on a scratch branch named probe/<this card id>-*, pushed to origin, triggered by push to that branch. Keep them off card/<id> so the integration queue never lands them. One probe should copy release.yml's job as it was at 97fe186 (git show 97fe186:.github/workflows/release.yml), up to and including its Test step. Running only this test with --exact is fine for repeat runs.
Allowed: pushing the scratch branch (no v* tags). Not allowed: touching main or tags directly, gh release, or editing release.yml/test.yml on main. Delete the scratch branch(es) on origin when finished.

## Acceptance
- A named cause, backed by evidence: a probe that fails at a stated rate, and a change that makes it pass in that same probe.
- The fix goes in the test or the product, whichever is wrong. Not allowed: lengthening the deadline, serializing tests, or retry loops.
- Three consecutive green full local runs. Put the CI probe results (configuration, run count, pass/fail) in the commit body.
- Record the finding where foreman-docs-and-writing says it belongs: a gotcha in the relevant docs/ feature doc, plus a foreman-debugging-playbook entry if it is a symptom others will hit.
- If no cause emerges after a reasonable census plus probe runs: block, with the census and the probe results in the reason.

## Gate
cargo build --target-dir target/agent
cargo test --target-dir target/agent
cargo fmt --check
You are INSIDE foreman (FOREMAN=1): never Stop-Process foreman; build only with --target-dir target/agent.
